concept.text: Objective response rate (ORR) Systemically assessed per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version (v) 1.1. ORR = complete response + partial response. Complete response is defined as the disappearance of all target or non-target lesions. Partial response is defined as at least a 30% decrease in the sum of the diameters of target or non-target lesions.
